shared.content: Use US English spelling (color, favorite, center, organize, defense).
Call the sport soccer, not football.

match-preview.content: Use the competition name from the fixture.
Keep the preview body to at most 80 words.
Always state the kickoff time with its time zone, for example 7:00 PM CT.

sitemap.content: Header menu order: Home, News, Fixtures, Standings, Squad, Videos.
When the club has a soccer team, give it Fixtures, Squad and Standings pages. Skip Statistics unless the brief asks for it.
